tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded browser session demonstrates how to browse a WordPress-style monthly archive: open an archive URL (?m=YYYYMM), read the sidebar Archive links, select a month, open a post from the archive list, and use the 'Older posts' / 'Newer posts' pagination (paged=N). The sequence is deterministic: archive pages, post permalinks and pagination URLs follow predictable query patterns (m=YYYYMM, paged=N).

Task Definition:
Create a reusable automation tool that (1) navigates to a specified monthly archive URL, (2) extracts the list of posts and sidebar archive links, (3) optionally opens a supplied post permalink, and (4) optionally navigates to a paged archive URL for older posts. The tool requires the base archive URL and archive month param; opening a post and paged navigation are optional.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to the provided base archive URL (must contain m=YYYYMM).
2. Extract the archive page contents: posts list, sidebar archives, and pagination links.
3. If a post_permalink is provided, open that post directly (deterministic navigation).
4. If follow_paged is provided, navigate to the archive paged URL by replacing/adding paged parameter to base URL.

Variable Identification:
- base_archive_url (string) — required. Actual starting URL used in recorded steps: 'http://localhost:8000/?m=202512'.
- archive_month_param (string) — required. e.g. '202512'.
- post_permalink (string) — optional. e.g. 'http://localhost:8000/?p=6'.
- follow_paged (string) — optional. e.g. '2' → navigates to '?m=YYYYMM&paged=2'.

Step Optimization:
- Use direct navigation to post permalinks instead of clicking page elements when possible (more deterministic).
- Replace sequences of UI clicks for pagination with a single navigation step to '?m=YYYYMM&paged=N'.
- Extraction step captures all necessary page data in one call so UI interactions are minimized.

Notes on requirements and assumptions:
- The site requires no authentication for the demonstrated actions, so no login steps are included.
- The recorded elementHash values were used to confirm click targets during recording, but steps are implemented via navigation and page extraction to be robust.
- The tool keeps steps deterministic and minimal: navigate -> extract -> optionally navigate to paged URL -> optionally open post permalink.

Justification for inputs:
- base_archive_url and archive_month_param are aligned to actual recorded values and used for deterministic URL operations.
- post_permalink and follow_paged are optional to allow listing-only runs.

This tool reproduces the essential interactions from the browser session and makes them parameterizable for different months, posts, and pagination pages.
name: browse_archive_and_open_post
description: Open a WordPress monthly archive by m=YYYYMM, list posts on that archive page, open a selected post by its permalink, and navigate archive pagination (Older/Newer posts). This tool reproduces the recorded browser steps: load archive, list sidebar archives, click chosen month, open chosen post, and follow pagination. The site requires no authentication.

steps.description: Open the archive landing page for the requested month (m=YYYYMM).
Collect the archive's post list, sidebar archive links and any 'Older posts'/'Newer posts' links.
steps.goal: Extract sidebar archives, list of posts (titles and permalinks), and pagination controls for the archive page.

steps.description: Resolve the requested post against the archive listing; this handles dynamic lists if needed.
steps.task: Find the permalink for the desired post '{post_permalink}' in the extracted archive data and prepare to open it if present.

steps.description: If follow_paged is set, navigate to the paged archive URL (?m=YYYYMM&paged=N) to load older posts.
If post_permalink is specified, navigate directly to that post's permalink to open the post page.

input_schema.name: base_archive_url
input_schema.description: Base archive URL with 'm' parameter set to desired month (e.g. 'http://localhost:8000/?m=202512'). The tool navigates to this URL first.

input_schema.name: archive_month_param
input_schema.description: Archive month in YYYYMM format used for navigation and pagination (e.g. '202512'). Must match the 'm' query parameter in base_archive_url.

input_schema.name: post_permalink
input_schema.description: Full permalink of the post to open from the archive (e.g. 'http://localhost:8000/?p=6'). If omitted, the tool will list posts but not open any post.

input_schema.name: follow_paged
input_schema.description: If provided (e.g. '2'), the tool will click/visit the 'Older posts' pagination link to load '?m=YYYYMM&paged={follow_paged}'. If omitted, no pagination click will be executed.
